notes: «رَوَى اَلْعِيصُ بْنُ اَلْقَاسِمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ» — the Imam named after «عن» inside the chain stays a narrator (owner ruling 2)
«قَالَ : سَأَلْتُهُ» — the asker is العيص, already the first link, so no new link is added (rule 5)
The opening «لِأَنَّهُ» is the compiler's argument before the chain; the closing gloss on the ghusl is not a link
